reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, good spot that the PVC list already used `a.ListOptions()` while StorageClasses and PVs right next to it ignored `--label-selector` and the resource-name filter.

Checked at `ab9a758`: both lists now go through `a.ListOptions()`, which only sets `LabelSelector` and the `metadata.name` field selector, so with no selector the request is the same as before. The multiple-default-StorageClass check counting only the selected classes follows from the selector scoping the list, same as every other analyzer. The new test covers both kinds with a labelled and an unlabelled object. CI is green, and codecov shows the test job ran (I didn't run it locally).

Good to merge.
